body:
Hi @Haroenv. After some intense session with Claude Code, I've achieved to make it work properly on my project. I've created #6875 with the code that fixes it. In the end it is a more refined version of what others did before.

When there's not connection (or something fails between the client and the server), no infinite loop happens now, preventing from "frying" the server with multiple calls.

SSR worked perfectly for me, along with widget/refinements initialisation, etc.

All feedback is appreciated, thanks!
